```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(GENESPACE)
```

# Syntenic Plots

Here, we can run orthofinder and genespace to check the synteny of each isolate.

The orthofinder we used is:

```{bash eval=FALSE}
orthofinder -f "$HOME/project_data/downy/genespace/tmp" -t 10 -a 10 -X -o "$HOME/project_data/downy/genespace/orthofinder"
```

Reference genomes: Peronospora effusa, Bremia lactucae, Phytophthora sojae

Our isolates: Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1, Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982, Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli

```{r  message=FALSE, echo=FALSE, results=FALSE}
genomeRepo <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/genomes/"
wd <- "~/project_data/downy/genespace/"
path2mcscanx <- "/Users/yixuanyang/miniforge3/bin/"

genomes2run <- c("Peronospora_effusa", "Bremia_lactucae", "Phytophthora_sojae")
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = genomes2run,
  genomeIDs = genomes2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  genespaceWd = wd)
asm2run <- c("Quesada_SQIIe_SC1982", "Quesada_SQIIe_MSU1", "Quesada_SQIIe_Phumuli")
parsedPaths <- parse_annotations(
  rawGenomeRepo = genomeRepo,
  genomeDirs = asm2run,
  genomeIDs = asm2run,
  headerSep = NA,
  headerEntryIndex = 1,
  gffIdColumn = "ID",
  genespaceWd = wd)

gpar <- init_genespace(
  wd = wd,
  nCores = 10,
  dotplots = 'never',
  path2mcscanx = path2mcscanx)

out <- run_genespace(gpar)
```

# Riparian

```{r echo=FALSE}
for (asm in asm2run){
  plot_riparian(
    gsParam = out,
    genomeIDs = c(asm, genomes2run[1]),
    refGenome = genomes2run[1],
    chrLabFontSize = 2,
    useRegions = FALSE)
}
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
full.plot <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = c(genomes2run[1],asm2run),
  refGenome = genomes2run[1],
  chrLabFontSize = 2,
  useRegions = FALSE)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
full.plot <- plot_riparian(
  gsParam = out,
  genomeIDs = c(genomes2run[3:1],asm2run[3:1]),
  refGenome = genomes2run[1],
  chrLabFontSize = 2,
  useRegions = FALSE)
```


# Phylogenetic Tree

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(ggtree)
tree.path <- file.path(wd, 'results/SpeciesTree_rooted.txt')
tree <- ggtree(read.tree(tree.path))
```


```{r}
library(patchwork)
tree + full.plot$plotData$ggplotObj + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 4))
```
